title: Build an AI Agent in 10 Minutes
full_monologue: Bold: Build an AI agent in 10 minutes—no code required. Start by defining its purpose, like a personal assistant or game bot. Next, use a no-code platform to set up the core functions. Then, train it with simple commands and examples. Finally, test and tweak until it works smoothly. It’s easier than you think. Ready to jump in? Let me know in the comments!
